patch_resolves_note: The staged official patch applies cleanly to the vulnerable GPAC checkout and the instrumented fixed original still reaches the `rtpin_satip_get_server_ip` terminator store. On that fixed run the raw loop index remains 1024, but the actual store index is clamped to 1023 before `text[...] = 0` executes, so the missing bound is genuinely satisfied on the stock PoC.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side read that materializes the attacker-controlled playlist line into the URL string later forwarded to source loading.

The server-name copy loop limits `i` only by the attacker-derived substring length and delimiter position, not by the 1024-byte `text` buffer. On the staged witness it exits with `i == 1024`, leaving no room for the terminator written immediately afterward.
AddressSanitizer sink. After the loop has left `i == 1024`, this statement writes a NUL terminator to `text[1024]`, one byte past the 1024-byte stack buffer.
The server-name copy loop exits with `i` already equal to the full `text` buffer capacity, leaving no byte available for the terminator written immediately afterward.

edges.description: The same loop index `i` computed when the server-name copy stops on the trailing delimiter is consumed as the raw index at the subsequent terminator store.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `satip_loop_exit.terminator_candidate_index == satip_terminator_store.raw_index == 1024`.
